description: State Ministry of Gem and Jewellery Related Industries - Amendet to the Gaz. Extraordinary No. 2165/02 dated 02.03.2020 (The Gem and Jewellery (License fee) No. 01 of 2020
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Industries under the National Gem and Jewellery Authority Act, No. 50 of 1993. It specifically amends license fee regulations for gem and jewellery exports, which constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory framework matters. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing legal/regulatory amendments, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel classification.
